course.title: NSEJS + SEHSS CRASH COURSE
course.description:
Special Features: 

1. PDF Notes of each Class will be uploaded on NEXT Toppers Application.

2. Daily Practice Problems (DPPs) with Video Solutions will be provided.

3.  Weekly Live Doubt support  will be provided. 

4.  A biweekly scheduled test will be provided according to the test planner.

5. Recorded Lecture will be Provided. 

6. After each test, a detailed test analysis and solution video will be provided. 

7. Well-structured and comprehensive study material will be provided to ensure thorough conceptual understanding and exam-oriented preparation.

8. The complete course will be accessible to all students until the Examination. 

9. This course is non-refundable.
